question: A character has already attuned to 3 magic items during a short rest. During the next adventuring day, they find Goggles of Night (which require attunement). What are the attunement rules — how many items can a character attune to, how does the process work, and what must this character do to attune to the Goggles?
expected_answer: A character can attune to no more than 4 magic items at a time. Attunement requires spending a Short Rest focused on the item while in physical contact with it (this can't be the same Short Rest used to identify it). Since the character already has 3 attuned items and the limit is 4, they can attune to the Goggles of Night by spending a Short Rest focused on them. Attunement ends if: the character no longer satisfies the prerequisites, the item is more than 100 feet away for 24+ hours, the character dies, or another creature attunes to the item. Without attunement, only nonmagical benefits of an item can be used.

bm25_simple.answer: Limit: 4 items (confirmed in body text p.102 AND Rules Glossary p.177-178). Process: Short Rest focused on item, physical contact, can't be same rest as identification. Since character has 3 and limit is 4, one slot remains — attune directly with a Short Rest. Ending conditions: prerequisites lost, 100+ ft for 24h, death, another creature attunes. Cursed items can't be voluntarily ended. Source: SRD p.102, 177-178.
